Marina (Partnerships): AcmeEdge asked if we can include seat changes in the marketplace usage webhook so they can prorate mid-cycle. They prefer one stream instead of separate adjustments. Risk: double-billing. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam (Integrations Eng): Can add fields but we need ordering/idempotency. Propose seat_snapshot + entitlement_sequence + idempotency_key.

Nina (Billing): Agree. Billing will compute prorate adjustments in cents using banker's rounding. Require entitlement_sequence to ensure idempotent application.

Alex (SRE): Add replay endpoint and rate limits. Monitor metric partner.entitlement.sequence.skew for gaps.

Marina (Partnerships): OK—Sam will draft webhook v2 schema, Nina will write a short RFC for prorate/rounding and invoice-window policy, Alex will add observability. Aim for partner beta next sprint.
